tasks.label: Check git status
tasks.command: git status --short && echo --- && git remote -v && echo --- && git branch --show-current

tasks.label: Commit auth changes
tasks.command: git add auth-system && git commit -m "Update auth flows and email OTP" -m "Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>"

tasks.label: Inspect git before push
tasks.command: git status --short --branch; git remote -v; git diff --stat; git diff --cached --stat

tasks.label: Review ahead commits
tasks.command: git --no-pager log --oneline --decorate origin/main..HEAD; git diff -- auth-system/middleware/validate.js

tasks.label: Commit signup validation update
tasks.command: git add auth-system/middleware/validate.js && git commit -m "Validate optional signup mobile number" -m "Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>"

tasks.label: Commit Google verification file
tasks.command: git add auth-system/public/google85d009984227fd2c.html && git commit -m "Add Google Search Console verification file" -m "Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>"
